verdict.rationale: Cerebras documents a tool-calling/function-calling capability (cerebras-docs-7) and touts long agent loops on open models (cerebras-docs-29), but there is no documentation or evidence specifically addressing parallel tool calls, multi-step tool-use reliability, or agent-loop robustness under tool calling; some community reports mention API formatting errors and request-limit issues in agentic use (cerebras-comm-8) suggesting friction. missing for 10: explicit parallel/multi-step tool-calling documentation, independent benchmarks or hands-on confirmation that agent loops run reliably with tool calls on Cerebras-hosted open models.
